full_prompt_en: A square sepia ink and light watercolor character illustration shows a horned traveler resting on a low stone bench beside a small doglike creature. The traveler sits at the right in profile facing left, knees bent and arms drawn loosely together. A dense, irregular bundle of twigs, folded material, and hornlike pieces crowns the head, with one long curved horn extending backward. A large tan backpack hangs behind a loose slate gray jacket, and beige trousers gather above sturdy dark boots. The face is long and weathered, with a downward gaze toward the little companion. At lower left, the dog sits upright amid sparse stems, tufts of grass, and a few tiny flowers. It has pointed ears, a short muzzle, and a cheerful open mouth turned toward the seated figure. A thin dark line marks the ground, but the surrounding space is largely untouched warm cream paper. The bench is only lightly defined, its top edge extending from behind the traveler toward the right border. Fine reddish brown ink lines trace clothes, fur, straps, and scattered vegetation; transparent gray and ocher washes settle into larger forms. Light seems broad and diffuse, leaving only modest shadow under the bench, boots, and animal. The composition is intimate and unhurried, its two differently sized companions linked by their inward glances. Sketchy looseness around the edges gives the scene the warmth of a storybook study rather than a polished poster.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形赭褐墨线与淡水彩角色插画描绘一位长角旅人坐在低矮石凳上休息，身旁是一只小狗般的生物。旅人位于右侧，朝左侧坐着，膝盖弯曲，双臂松松收拢。头顶堆着细枝、折叠材料与角状片组成的不规则浓密一团，一根长而弯的角向后伸。大浅棕背包挂在宽松石板灰外套后，米色长裤在结实的深色靴子上方堆出褶皱。脸修长而饱经风霜，低头看向小伙伴。左下，小狗坐在稀疏草茎、草丛和几朵小花间。它有尖耳、短口鼻和朝向坐者的快乐张口。细深线标出地面，周围大部分空间保留暖奶油白纸张。凳子只轻轻界定，顶边从旅人身后延向右边框。细红棕墨线追踪衣服、毛发、背带和零散植被；通透灰色与赭色洗色落入较大形体。光宽广漫射，仅在凳子、靴子和动物下方留下适度阴影。构图亲密而从容，大小不同的两位伙伴由向内的目光联系。边缘的速写松动感让场景像温暖的童话习作，而非磨光的海报。
style_prompt_en: Character focused ink and wash illustration uses nimble reddish brown contour lines, exploratory sketch marks, and very restrained transparent color over warm cream paper. A compact cluster of overlapping shapes is placed within generous blank space, giving small gestures and textural details room to register. Earthy tan and ocher warm the image; slate blue gray blocks provide a quiet counterweight. Lines vary from crisp narrow edges to loose construction strokes, with crosshatching in folds and pockets of shadow. Irregular protrusions and bundled materials give the silhouette an inventive, handmade complexity, while the larger body masses remain simple. Broad diffuse light creates soft shallow shadows and avoids hard theatrical contrast. Ground is indicated with only a few broken strokes and scattered delicate marks. The overall mood is gentle, curious, and lived in, like a carefully observed sketch from an imagined world.
style_prompt_zh: 以角色为重心的墨线洗色插画在暖奶油白纸上使用灵活红棕轮廓、探索性速写笔痕和极克制的透明颜色。紧凑的重叠形体群放在宽裕空白里，让小动作与肌理细节得到呼吸。土黄与赭色温暖画面，石板蓝灰色块提供安静平衡。线条从清晰窄边变化到松散结构笔触，褶皱和阴影小块内有排线。不规则突起与捆扎材料赋予剪影富于想象的手工复杂度，较大的体块仍然简洁。宽广漫射光形成柔软浅影，避免生硬戏剧对比。地面仅用少量断续笔划和零散纤细痕迹指示。整体温柔、好奇且有生活痕迹，像从想象世界中仔细观察得到的一幅速写。
theme_en: A horned traveler seated beside a small dog on a quiet path
theme_zh: 长角旅人与小狗在安静小径旁相坐
name: Claire Wendling
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
